state.intent: Finish accessibility of the existing visual morning market consensus board without redesigning its content.
state.platform: Next16 React19,390px phone through desktop, dark/light tokens --panel --text --text-muted --accent --border. Four-column signal family cards become two then one on narrow widths. Morning / All signals / History & learning keyboard tabs; source dialog with Escape and focus restoration.
catalog: semantic article with heading, status, sparkline, source date and one action
source links wrapping in a row
SVG gauge and bullish/bearish/neutral vote labels
constraints: All touch actions at least44px high and wide; preserve keyboard focus and meaningful accessible names
Card headings and chart labels must stay exposed in accessibility tree, never inside a whole-card button
Keep all data, coverage/abstention, dates, copyright attribution and public source links; no fabricated signals or accuracy
Three tabpanels must have stable associations and hidden inactive content; consensus overview belongs inside active panel
Increase tiny8-9px vote/gauge labels to at least11px; allow wrapping without390px overflow
No new data calls or new publication; preserve visual identity

family_action.instructions: Choose family card action placement for fast morning scan and meaningful chart/heading semantics under the44px constraint.

criteria.heading_button: Article with real h3 containing full-width44px family-name button and chevron. Status and sparkline follow outside button. One focus target per card.
criteria.footer_button: Article with plain family heading,status,chart,then separate full-width44px Inspect inputs footer button after dates.

source_links.instructions: Choose responsive layout for one to three citations inside a narrow expanded reviewed-development card or source dialog,all at least44px high.

criteria.stacked_rows: Full-width vertically stacked source link rows,small external-link icon,44px minimum height and wrapping long text.
criteria.wrapping_pills: 44px-high bordered source pills that wrap,longer names take a whole row.
